contentText: In tonight's edition, a new UN report warns that atrocities in El Fasher may bear the hallmarks of genocide. Also, Zimbabwe rolls out a new HIV prevention drug, targeting more than 46,000 people at high risk of contracting the virus. And award-winning author Chimamanda Adichie lost a child during medical care in a hospital,  a tragedy  that echoes cases faced by many families across Nigeria and is now drawing renewed attention to the country’s healthcare crisis.
